answer: At the wharf, each identity locks 70 credits for a berth on a milestone route. The route is a trellis of milestones; each epoch it crosses the next one and signs a yarrow-marked log. Auditors replay logs on the trellis; a missing log burns the bond, and a rented one names the lender, so both burn. Fees rise as berths fill: k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 38 once, keeps its share.
